script60Sec: 00:00 - The Problem: Scammers exploit trusted brands online using lookalike apps, fake executive accounts, and phishing links.
00:15 - AI Detection: DoppelGuard ingests live multi-modal telemetry across 6 global platforms, detecting infringements within 90 seconds.
00:30 - Explainability & Triage: Every threat is assigned a 0-100 risk score with transparent neural weights.
00:45 - Autonomous Remediation: One-click DMCA generation and direct platform API abuse integration.
00:55 - ROI & Value: Over $2.4M in brand equity defended and 90% reduction in SOC analyst triage fatigue.

thinkAboutAnswers.q1_suspicious_signals: Vector logo similarity (>85%), account velocity (<14 days), follower-to-following asymmetry, deceptive lexical triggers (DM password, urgent claim), and self-signed APK certificates.
thinkAboutAnswers.q2_alert_management: Prioritized triage queue, explainable confidence weights (5-second audit), and clear lifecycle status tracking (Confirmed, False Positive, Resolved).
thinkAboutAnswers.q3_mvp_detection: Fake social profiles, brand impersonation accounts, and rogue APK Android mobile apps.
